checks.message: Concurrent requests share a single model construction
Desktop retains at most two built regions
Oldest inactive region is evicted before new construction
Only the evicted region loses points and references
Eviction releases geometry, materials, both terrain textures, instance buffers and water environment
Cached-region access applies the reduced mobile capacity
Viewport resize releases the inactive region immediately
Mobile keeps one region and no orphan roots
Failed queued load clears its pending promise
Superseded navigation skips an obsolete queued scene
